subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• In the early 1800s, over 2,800 distinct languages were spoken across the Americas.
• European colonization and forced assimilation policies in the 19th and 20th centuries led to the suppression of indigenous languages.
• Hundreds of indigenous languages were abandoned as speakers were prohibited from using them in schools and official settings.
• Today, fewer than 300 indigenous languages remain actively spoken in the Americas.
• The Endangered Language Project, supported by Google, works to document and revitalize threatened indigenous languages.
prompt: The student wants to emphasize the decline in indigenous languages in the Americas and specify why this decline occurred. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish these goals?

choices.A: The Endangered Language Project works to document some of the indigenous languages lost following colonization and assimilation policies in recent centuries.
choices.B: Following European colonization and forced assimilation policies, hundreds of indigenous languages in the Americas were lost as speakers were prohibited from using them in schools and official settings.
choices.C: While over 2,800 distinct languages were spoken across the Americas in the early 1800s, fewer than 300 indigenous languages remain actively spoken today.
choices.D: As European colonization expanded in the 19th and 20th centuries, the linguistic diversity of many regions around the world decreased significantly.

explanation: Choice B is the best answer. The sentence emphasizes the decline in indigenous languages in the Americas and specifies why this decline occurred, noting that hundreds of languages were lost due to European colonization and forced assimilation policies that prohibited their use.
